# arin_customer (Resource)

Manage an ARIN customer record for a simple network reassignment. Creation does not itself reassign address space. Changes to parent_net_handle require replacement. Delete the dependent reassignment before deleting its customer. Name and address attributes are sensitive but remain in Terraform state. Import using PARENT-NET-HANDLE/CUSTOMER-HANDLE.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use a parent network registered to your organization.
# This creates the recipient only, without reassigning address space.
resource "arin_customer" "example" {
  parent_net_handle = "NET-192-0-2-0-1"
  name              = "Example Customer"
  country_code      = "US"
  city              = "Chantilly"
  subdivision       = "VA"
  postal_code       = "20151"
  street_address    = ["123 Test Street", "Suite 2"]
  private_customer  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) Uppercase two-letter country code.
- `name` (String, Sensitive) Customer name.
- `parent_net_handle` (String) Parent network used to create the recipient. Creation-only context retained in state and required during import.
- `street_address` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered street address lines. At least one line is required.

### Optional

- `city` (String, Sensitive) Customer city. Omission sends an empty value.
- `comments` (List of String, Sensitive) Ordered operational comments. Omission clears comments.
- `postal_code` (String, Sensitive) Postal code. Required for US and CA customers.
- `private_customer` (Boolean) Hide the customer name and address from public registration output. Defaults to false.
- `subdivision` (String, Sensitive) State or province code. Required for US and CA customers.

### Read-Only

- `country_name` (String) Country name returned by ARIN.
- `id` (String) ARIN-generated customer handle.
- `parent_org_handle` (String) Parent organization assigned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) Registration date generated by ARIN and preserved on updates.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Include the parent network because the customer response does not return it.
terraform import arin_customer.example NET-192-0-2-0-1/C12345678
```
